title: Tatar — Russian passport (ICAO/MVD) with Tatar letters
authority: MVD Russia Order No. 996 (2019) / ICAO Doc 9303 for the Russian letters; Tatar letters by fallback
description: Russian international-passport transliteration (ICAO Doc 9303 / MVD) extended to the Tatar letters: Ә→A, Ө→O, Ү→U, Җ→ZH, Ң→N, Һ→H. Arabic-loan spellings гый/кый give GI/KI and the hardening ъ after г/к is dropped, matching Russian forms (Гыйльмиев → Gilmiev as Гильмиев).
notes: Holders are Russian citizens: their passports carry Russian-form Cyrillic names romanized with the MVD/ICAO table (ru_icao), which has no entries for the national letters. The extra mappings here are fallbacks for input in native spelling; the real passport form depends on how the name was Russified.

Russian-form equivalents behind the fallbacks: Ә→А/Я/Э (Сәлимә → Салима), Ө→О/Ё, Ү→У/Ю, Җ→Дж/Ж, Ң→Н/НГ, Һ→Х/Г. Generate DZH for Җ and KH for Һ as variants (Җәлил → Джалиль → DZHALIL; Һади → Хади → KHADI).
ICAO Doc 9303 §6.B prints Һ as C, apparently an error; Һ→H is used, as in every national and PCGN table.
Tatar Latin (Zamanälif) is the official romanization in Tatarstan since 2012 but Cyrillic is the only official script; see tt_bgn_pcgn for the PCGN romanization.
